title: Demo: client-side Game of Life
description: Grid with click-to-toggle, play/pause/step/reset. Simulation is pure Elixir in actions driven by a delayed self-scheduling action (like the dashboard tick); no commands. Show a '0 server requests' counter. Highlights Elixir running in the browser.
design:
# hd-24p.1 Game of Life — design (Codex Architect, verified against Hologram 0.12.7 source)

Route /life. Page title "Game of Life · Holodeck"; crumbs Home / Game of Life.
Home card body: "Explore Conway's cellular automaton." Feature caption: "Client-side Elixir · delayed actions · zero simulation commands".

Board: 24x24 finite (cells outside the edges are dead). State lives on the page (no board component; nested components are Kanban's lesson).
State: %{cells: tuple of 576 0/1, running: false, loop_token: 0, delay_ms: 200, generation: 0, population: n}
Cell id = y*24+x; read with elem/2, toggle with put_elem/3; next generation via Enum.map then List.to_tuple/1. Avoid maps/MapSet: the runtime's :maps.put clones (deps/hologram/assets/js/erlang/maps.mjs:384).
Per tick: 576 cells evaluated, up to 4,608 neighbour reads, 576 buttons rendered. Hologram re-renders + vdom patches; keep the element count and order fixed; no per-cell components.
Controls: Play/Pause; Step (only while paused); Clear; Randomise (:rand.uniform/0, ~25% occupancy, supported client-side in rand.mjs); presets Glider, Blinker, Pulsar; speed select 100/200/500/1000 ms (default 200); generation + population counters. Initial: paused, gen 0, centred glider. Clear/Randomise/preset pause and reset generation. Clicking cells works while playing.
Tick loop with a token (put_action has no cancel handle; navigation drops page actions):
  :play -> if not running: token+1, running: true, schedule_tick(token)
  :pause -> running: false, token+1
  :tick %{token: t} -> only if running and t == loop_token: advance, then schedule_tick(t); else no-op
  schedule_tick: put_action(name: :tick, delay: delay_ms, params: %{token: token})
  speed change: validate against the allowlist, token+1, reschedule one tick if running. Stale timers can't advance or reschedule, so Pause/Play can't double the loop.
Honesty: show "Elixir running in your browser" and "Simulation server commands: 0", with the text "After loading, every control and generation runs locally." (an architectural statement, not a fake network counter).
Accessibility: native <button> cells with stable ids, aria-pressed, coordinate labels, visible focus, >=24px cells; horizontal scroll allowed on narrow screens; no per-cell animation; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Files: lib/holodeck/life.ex (pure rules, presets, population, random board); lib/holodeck_web/pages/life/life_page.{ex,holo}; test/holodeck/life_test.exs; test/holodeck_web/pages/life/life_page_test.exs. No commands/subscriptions/migrations.
Tests: empty board, still life, blinker period 2, glider moves, edge behaviour, preset bounds/population; play twice -> one loop; stale ticks rejected after pause/play and speed change; paused Step advances once; Clear/Randomise/preset invalidate timers; every action leaves next_command nil.
Alternatives rejected: MapSet of {x,y} (allocation/encoding cost), integer-keyed map (needless at this size), canvas (interop + accessibility cost).
Estimate: 250–400 impl lines.
notes: Moved to a separate session at the user's request. Partial unreviewed WIP is on branch demo/life (a619c81): engine, page, tests started. Full design is in this ticket's DESIGN field.

title: Demo: shared Kanban board
description: Columns/cards as stateful components with their own cid; optimistic moves persisted via command and broadcast to other clients; drag-and-drop via Hologram.JS (native DnD or SortableJS). Highlights nested stateful components and targeted actions.
design:
# hd-24p.2 Shared Kanban — design (Codex Architect, verified against Hologram 0.12.7 source)

Route /kanban. Title "Shared Kanban · Holodeck"; crumbs Home / Shared Kanban.
Home card body: "Move cards together on a shared board." Caption: "Nested stateful components · targeted actions · optimistic updates".

Storage: ONE public Postgres board, capped at 30 cards; titles 1–120 trimmed chars; columns fixed "todo" | "doing" | "done".
Tables: kanban_boards (singleton string id "public", monotonic revision, next_position, last_reset_at); kanban_cards (uuid id, board fk, title, column, integer position, integer version, timestamps). Generate the migration with mix ecto.gen.migration create_kanban_board; insert the singleton plus 6 example cards in the migration; DB check constraints for columns and title bounds; index on board/column/position.
Every mutation runs in a transaction that locks the board row first: validate, enforce the cap, mutate, increment revision, return a full snapshot.
Ordering: append to the destination column (new monotonic position on add/cross-column move; sort by position then id). No within-column reorder in v1; same-column move is a no-op.
Reset demo board: confirmation + the displayed expected revision + a global 60s cooldown; new uuids; revision increments (never resets). Label the board as public/shared.

Component tree (only Board subscribes to {:kanban, "public"} and runs commands):
  BoardPage ("page") -> Board ("kanban-board": confirmed snapshot + optimistic overlay; add form, Sync, Reset, status)
    -> Column ("kanban-column-todo|doing|done") -> Card ("kanban-card-<uuid>") x N
Board state: %{confirmed: %{revision, cards}, pending: nil | %{seq, card_id, expected_version, destination}, request_seq, draft_title, error, reset_confirmation}
Display = confirmed + pending overlay; never overwrite confirmed with speculation. Columns/Cards take data as props (no duplicated card state; usage-rules: don't copy props into same-named state). Card owns delete-confirmation UI state.
Targeted-action path (the teaching point): Card Move button -> targets its Column -> Column forwards with put_action(target: "kanban-board") -> Board creates the optimistic move + command. Card cids are independent of column.

DnD: Hologram's event dispatcher has no native drag events, so use a colocated ES module via Hologram.JS:
  js_import :install, from: "./drag_drop.js", as: :install_drag_drop; Board action :mount_drag_drop does JS.call(:install_drag_drop, ["kanban-board-root", "kanban-board"]), queued from Board init.
  drag_drop.js: idempotent install (WeakSet); delegated dragstart/dragover/drop on the board root; dataTransfer type "application/x-holodeck-card" with {card_id, expected_version}; on drop, validate and call Hologram.dispatchAction("request_move", boardCid, {...data, destination}) (public API, hologram.mjs:214). Never move DOM nodes directly. Render cards draggable with data-card-id/data-version, columns with data-column.
  Visible Move buttons for keyboard/touch use the same Board action; polite live region for outcomes; restore focus after a keyboard move.

Optimism: one pending mutation per browser (other mutating controls disabled; Sync stays enabled). Only moves are optimistic; add/delete wait for confirmation.
  request_move: pending = %{seq: request_seq+1, ...}; put_command(:move_card, pending); put_action(name: :move_timeout, delay: 10_000, params: %{seq})
  command(:move_card): Kanban.move_card(params) (all params untrusted; version compared inside the locked transaction, incremented on success)
    {:ok, snapshot} -> put_broadcast({:kanban, "public"}, :receive_snapshot, snapshot: snapshot) |> put_action(:move_settled, seq, status: :ok, snapshot)
    {:error, reason, snapshot} -> put_action(:move_settled, seq, status: reason, snapshot)
  Reconcile:
    - accept snapshots only if revision > confirmed revision;
    - clear pending only on the matching seq;
    - keep the overlay while the card's version is unchanged;
    - if the card changed or disappeared, drop the overlay;
    - on conflict, show "This card changed in another browser. Showing the latest board.";
    - on timeout, clear, announce, and fetch a snapshot (no auto-retry);
    - late replies can't clear a newer pending.
  Load a fresh snapshot after mount, on window focus, and via a Sync board button (broadcasts have no replay or order guarantee).
Files: lib/holodeck/kanban.ex (snapshot/0, add_card/1, move_card/1, delete_card/1, reset_board/1); lib/holodeck/kanban/{board,card}.ex; generated migration; lib/holodeck_web/pages/kanban/board_page.{ex,holo}; lib/holodeck_web/components/kanban/{board,column,card}.{ex,holo} + drag_drop.js; tests: kanban_test (validation, cap under concurrent adds, append order, concurrent moves from one version => one ok + one conflict, delete-vs-move, reset-vs-move, cooldown; real concurrency via separate DB connections), component tests (targeting chain, reconciliation cases), page test.
Tests use %Hologram.Component{}/%Hologram.Server{} callback style (Hologram.Test's FeatureHelpers are private and need a browser dep).
Estimate: 700–1,000 impl lines + tests; split into persistence -> components -> DnD interop -> integration.
notes: Moved to a separate session at the user's request. Open decisions: board access (recommend: anyone, with a 30-card cap and reset with confirmation + 60s cooldown), persistence (recommend Postgres), ordering (recommend append-only v1).
